description: ESPN soccer scoreboard for one league and date: each match with home and away team, score, status (scheduled, live, full time) and stadium, from ESPN's public site JSON. Default league is the English Premier League (eng.1); times are UTC. Choose this tool for: ESPN soccer scoreboard for one league and date: each match. Close alternatives on this server: dev_espn_wnba (ESPN WNBA scoreboard for one date: each game with home); dev_espn_college_football (ESPN college football scoreboard for one date: every game). Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

league.description: ESPN league code, e.g. eng.1, esp.1, ger.1, ita.1, fra.1, uefa.champions (default eng.1)
